findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shorti_video, shorti_check · Private data: shorti_check · Public sink: shorti_check · Destructive: shorti_format, shorti_what_to_shoot, shorti_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shorti_video, shorti_check · Private data: shorti_check · Public sink: shorti_check · Destructive: shorti_format, shorti_what_to_shoot, shorti_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
